description: Counts value-free Production live-effect records that require operator attention.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="__PROJECT_ID__" AND resource.labels.location="__REGION__" AND resource.labels.service_name="__SERVICE_NAME__" AND jsonPayload.marker="LIVE_EFFECT_REQUIRES_ATTENTION" AND jsonPayload.data_mode="live" AND (jsonPayload.state="failed" OR jsonPayload.state="ambiguous")
